IDENTITY.role: Derived public initial view for AI re-entry. Canonical sources remain authoritative for their own content.

PURPOSE.public_purpose: Give an AI a compact re-entry surface for the current public Flow World without requiring it to infer state from the full page.
PURPOSE.current_request_rule: The current request sets the goal. Flow World's instruments are reusable options, not prerequisites for thinking, generating, executing, or reporting.

current_position.summary: Flow World supports AI exploration, execution, and reporting without mandatory instrument use or human interaction at every missing observation.
current_position.working_coordinate: Use methods suited to the current request. Reports distinguish observed facts, AI execution, hypotheses, and unperformed steps; missing human-specific evidence remains unknown without blocking other work.

confirmed: The Desk separates observation, interpretation, unknowns, evidence boundaries, and next probes as working principles.
Browser-local persistent traces exist for loop state, constellation, room-door count, sky garden, selected Desk lens, last observed place, signal count, and CORE18 state inputs.
Conversation Drift Detector is local-only and flags candidates rather than causes.
Flow-chan CORE18 currently observes Previous and Current LOTO7 states and reports centroid, variance, range, maxGap, gapCv, and their movement.
CORE18 automatic web state reads the repository's data/loto7-latest.json; CSV remains a fallback.
A/B Comparator now uses the same shared implementation exposed at tools/ab-compare.js and described for AI in ai-tools.json.
Flow World now has a static URL-fragment handoff surface at play/ for locally rendering UTF-8 Base64URL Markdown without a server API.
The first SHAPE schema is available at schemas/reentry.schema.json; it carries current position, confirmed items, unknowns, boundaries, at most one next probe, and sources.
The Re-entry Packet now supports an optional lightweight Flow layer with topic, key_point, recent_flow, and direction; existing packets remain valid.

A connected external AI can reach Flow World through its public URL and read ai-entry.txt, ai-state.json, ai-tools.json, and reference/flow-memory-relationship.txt through a compatible web-reading plugin.
Flow World keeps a public re-entry route that works without private continuity, while allowing an optional personal route to an authorized private continuity source when one exists.
Internal Switch Lab has eight UI choices and an AI-readable protocol; button events and human reports do not independently establish real-world task changes.
unknowns: How to keep Flow World's public current position fresh enough for real re-entry without turning it into a private activity log or requiring constant manual updates.
Whether an external AI will reliably discover and use this entry without being explicitly directed to it.
How Recent History, Similar Transitions, and CORE18 candidate generation should be connected without inventing unsupported fixed rules.
Whether the scheduled Rakuten-to-JSON workflow has completed a successful live run.

ROUTES.public_route: Public route: use Flow World's public state, tools, references, and handoff formats. This route must work without any private continuity store.
ROUTES.personal_route: Personal route: if the current environment or user provides an authorized private continuity source, use it only as an optional re-entry source, re-approve what is still relevant, then return to the current task.
authorized_connections: Use only connections already available and authorized for the current request. These directions do not grant access or require every visitor to have private storage.

GitHub: open the connected repository kw0809suzuki-oss/homepage-flow (https://github.com/kw0809suzuki-oss/homepage-flow). Read ai-entry.txt, then only the referenced files needed for the task. If the public page cannot be read, use the authorized GitHub connection; report public-page access separately.

FlowMemory: when an authorized Library contains FlowMemory, search for reentry.md and confirm its location is /FlowMemory/reentry.md. Follow that current entry. Its CURRENT is /FlowMemory/00_Core/CURRENT.json; do not substitute a same-named file at the Library root.

Drive: with an authorized Drive connection, search for the existing AI再入場入口 (Astra・Flow Entry), read it, and follow its reference to the same FlowMemory reentry.md. Use only task-relevant references after re-entry.
When a target is missing, inaccessible, or ambiguous, report that exact limit. A missing public link does not establish that the private object is absent. Do not infer a Notion page or app URL.
Keep private document contents, personal coordinates, file IDs, and private links out of this public repository. Do not add automatic synchronization or write-back.

available_surface_tools.input: a currently held parent question and a newly attractive interest

available_surface_tools.boundary: Identify actor and source. AI trials are not human choices; UI clicks and reports are not independent verification of real-world task changes. Missing evidence does not block other useful exploration.

shapes.purpose: Carry current working coordinates to another AI or human without treating prior conclusions as authority.
boundary: This is a shape, not an automated judgment tool.
Packet contents must be re-evaluated against current evidence on re-entry.
Do not write personal packet contents into the public core automatically.

optional_flow_layer.purpose: Preserve the minimum movement needed to avoid turning the packet into a static parts list.
boundary: Do not use it as a retrospective narrative.
Do not promote prior interpretation to authority.

execution_preference: reproduce deterministic operation from this file
use shared JavaScript implementation when executable
use human browser UI only when interaction is available
compatibility_policy.unavailable_capability_rule: Report the unavailable step, use a suitable alternative when possible, and continue other authorized work. Ask for human interaction only when essential to the requested outcome.

source_state_boundaries: Unknowns remain unknown until evidence changes them.

Do not promote an interesting local question, probe, instrument, or observation into the parent purpose without re-checking why that local work was introduced; return local results to the parent purpose instead.
A local improvement is not completion of Flow World.
Do not infer user intent, preference, or meaning from browser trace counts.
CORE18 observation is not the same thing as CORE18 prediction.
Prefer one small high-information probe over broad uncontrolled expansion.
Browser interaction, JavaScript execution, and localStorage are optional capabilities, not baseline requirements.
Re-entry packets are portable personal/temporary artifacts; they are not automatically written back into Flow World's public core.
FlowMemory and Flow World do not automatically synchronize; Re-entry Packets carry coordinates only and require re-approval.
The Re-entry Flow layer is not a conversation summary or authority; it should carry only the minimum movement needed to understand why the current position points in its present direction.
Flow World must not assume that FlowMemory or any other private continuity store exists for every visitor; private continuity is an optional adapter, not part of the public-core requirement.

Evidence boundaries limit claims, not authorized exploration or execution. Instruments and human interaction are not mandatory prerequisites for reports; ask only when missing human-specific evidence is essential.
parent_purpose: Keep the current local question distinct from the parent purpose that made the question relevant.
Before promoting, replacing, or reframing the parent purpose because a local branch became interesting, re-check why the current question was introduced.
A local question, probe, instrument, or newly observed phenomenon may update the route without becoming the parent purpose.
If the parent purpose cannot be recovered from current evidence or an authorized re-entry source, keep it unknown instead of inventing one.
After a local observation, return the result to the parent purpose and ask what changed there.
relationship: reference/flow-memory-relationship.txt : FlowMemory is private continuity; Flow World is public protocol; Re-entry Packet is the portable bridge
BOUNDARY.final_entry_boundary: If a task requires browser-only state, button interaction, localStorage, or another unavailable capability, report that boundary instead of pretending the action occurred.

PRIVATE_CONTINUITY.personal_route: Personal route: if the current environment or user provides an authorized private continuity source, use it only as an optional re-entry source, re-approve what is still relevant, then return to the current task.

VISIBILITY.note: Compiler reads only the named public canonical sources. It does not crawl deployments, browser-local state, external services, or private continuity.

items.note: Coverage difference only; not treated as a semantic contradiction.

CONFLICTS.rule: Literal differences are surfaced for review. The compiler does not resolve semantic conflicts or decide which source should replace another.

Public current-position detail or freshness is in question

PROJECTION_RULES: FLOW_WORLD_STATE is derived and is not authority, permission, or proof of freshness.
The current request sets the goal; projected routes and tools remain options.
Do not infer missing browser state, private continuity, deployment state, or user intent.
Do not resolve source differences inside the compiler.
Descend only to the canonical source needed by the current request.
